title: Reconnecting Through a Garden
paragraphs: Setelah ayahnya pensiun, Bilal menyadari ayahnya menghabiskan sebagian besar hari di dalam rumah. Seluruh keluarga khawatir karena ia tampak kurang bersemangat. Bilal mengusulkan kebun sayur kecil di halaman belakang. Ayahnya setuju terutama untuk menyenangkan putranya.

Pada minggu-minggu berikutnya, mereka merawat kebun itu bersama. Kegiatan itu memberi mereka rutinitas baru dan lebih banyak hal untuk dibicarakan. Menjelang musim panen, ayah Bilal tampak lebih cerah. Bilal merasa kebun itu menumbuhkan lebih dari sayuran; kebun itu mendekatkan mereka.
answerKey: After his father retired, Bilal noticed that he spent most days indoors. The whole family worried because he seemed less energetic than before. Bilal suggested starting a small vegetable garden in the backyard. His father agreed mainly to make his son happy. In the following weeks, they cared for the garden together. It gave them a new routine and more to talk about. By harvest season, Bilal's father seemed brighter. Bilal felt that the garden had grown more than vegetables; it had brought them closer.
